# E0417: a condition reads an optional field

A lacuna's `when` may read fields the source always has, and may test an
optional field's presence, but may not read an optional field's value: nothing
proves the condition evaluates when the field is absent.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	name:   string
	count?: int
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	name:  string
	count: int
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		count: orelse(v0_0.count, 0)
	}
	lacunas: {
		count: [{
			type:    PrecisionLoss
			message: "counts above 1000 are rounded downstream"
			when:    v0_0.count != _|_ && v0_0.count > 1000
		}]
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0417]: count is optional in 0.0, and a condition reading an optional field is not supported yet
  --> 1.0.thema:15:34
   |
15 |             when:    v0_0.count != _|_ && v0_0.count > 1000
   |                                           ^^^^
   |
   = help: a condition may test its presence: v0_0.count != _|_
```
